evidence: Source review against the local C# reference, with three stale round3 captures. No current application screenshots, real-device or other-platform validation.
findings: Change Alt sends guided position current=2 instead of altitude-only current=3; Change Speed parameters differ.
Joystick button actions absent and Manual Control flag ignored by the sender.
Unit conversions are missing from PLAN editing, gauges, status and action inputs.
Planner GCS ID, log path and serial reset settings are stored but not applied.
One physical link only; the sysid selector changes vehicles on that transport.
DroneCAN interface actions have no implementation.
Mobile file selection and serial adapters remain incomplete; no installable iOS wrapper.
External scripts lack Mission Planner's injected automation object model.
Plugin manager lists files without executing plugins or supporting lifecycle methods.
Language and Basic/Advanced layout selection do not apply the expected behavior.
Password Protect Config stores a checkbox without protecting navigation.
Camera discovery, GStreamer/HereLink and recording the rendered HUD are incomplete.
PLAN MAVFTP checkbox does not select packed mission/fence/rally transfer.
Place geocoding, live KML and GDAL raster/opacity behavior are absent or substituted.
Raw parameter editing lacks reference read-only/range confirmations and typed bitmask editing.
regressions: No newly introduced regression substantiated against the prior commit.
next_round: Joystick functions and protocol mismatches first, then operational Planner settings and units. Do not award 10 without substantiated parity.
